# Error #99: InvalidPauseTransition

<!-- Generated by tooling/generate-error-catalog.mjs. Do not edit manually. -->

## Summary
- **Numeric Code**: `#99`
- **Variant Name**: `InvalidPauseTransition`
- **Status**: Active (Enforced)
- **Client Toast Level**: `WARNING`
- **Retryable**: `Yes`

---

## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::PauseAlreadyPaused` — the stream is already paused.
- `Branch::ResumeNotPaused` — the stream is not paused.

---

Focused regression test: [`contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::only_the_sender_pauses_and_double_transitions_are_rejected`](../../contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::only_the_sender_pauses_and_double_transitions_are_rejected). The matrix arm below is the smallest direct construction; `rejected!` records the fired branch and asserts its mapped code.

```rust
// PauseAlreadyPaused — excerpt from error_surface_test.rs
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let id = f.create_stream(DEPOSIT, DAY, 10 * DAY, false);
f.client.mock_all_auths().pause_stream(&f.sender, &id);
Some(rejected!(f
    .client
    .mock_all_auths()
    .try_pause_stream(&f.sender, &id)))
```

Run the focused test:

```bash
cargo test -p streampay-contract --locked only_the_sender_pauses_and_double_transitions_are_rejected
```

---

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Call `pause_stream` only while the stream is active and unpaused, and `resume_stream` only while it is paused; re-read the stream status before retrying.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#6-lifecycle-states`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#6-lifecycle-states)
